item.title: Multiple Republican leaders in Wisconsin State Legislature to retire this year
item.description: The Republican-dominated state legislature will see multiple prominent leaders retire and not seek reelection this November.

item.title: Jon Husted touts endorsement from Ohio lawmaker who admitted questionable behavior with a minor
item.description: On Thursday, U.S. Sen. Jon Husted (R-OH) released a list of endorsements from Ohio lawmakers, including state Rep. Rodney Creech (R-West Alexandria) who admitted to questionable behavior involving a minor.

item.title: Mariannette Miller-Meeks took tens of thousands from insurance PACs while opposing ACA tax credit extension
item.description: U.S. Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks’ (R-IA) campaign finance records show she took at least $45,500 from the insurance and pharmaceutical lobby after repeatedly opposing extending the Affordable Care Act’s (ACA) premium tax credits.

item.title: Report: Vivek Ramaswamy shelled out $12K in campaign funds on luxury Puerto Rico vacation
item.description: Campaign finance records for Ohio gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy (R) show that the Republican candidate used nearly $12,000 in campaign money for a luxury trip to Puerto Rico last November.

item.title: Palantir-linked donations riddle Michigan Senate race, McMorrow returned the money
item.description: A Sunday report from Detroit News shows that three Michigan Senate candidates have accepted campaign donations from the tech company Palantir, which has a $30 million federal contract with Immigrations and Customs Enforcement (ICE).

item.title: Tennessee Senate allows lawsuits over transgender ‘coercion’
item.description: The Tennessee Senate passed legislation Monday allowing patients to sue their doctor for “coercing” them into seeking gender reassignment some 30 years after treatment. Republican Sen. Adam Lowe of Calhoun passed Senate Bill 2031 24-5 although he was unable to provide evidence that physicians are persuading people to seek transgender care.
